newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade very slow until near 1600CST/2200GMT Wednesday then became very active.
Slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 higher. Inquiry good, demand fair early, good late.
Sales confirmed on 34,100 slaughter steers and 37,900 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
Slaughter steers Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1350 lbs 64.00; few Select with end Choice 62.00-64.00; few Select and Choice 1275 lb Holsteins 57.00.
Dressed Basis Few Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 101.00-103.00.
Slaughter heifers Select and Choice 990-1150 lbs 64.00, couple pens 63.00-63.50; few Select with end Choice 63.00; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1050-1175 lb heifers and heiferettes 62.00-63.50.
Dressed basis Few Select and Choice 2-3 1075 lbs 104.00, hot weight, delivered. Confirmed 72000 last week 5300 last year 39100
Week to date 101300 last week 55500 last year 51000
